sentences.text: Under the Geneva Agreement, French forces gradually left the Hà Nội area.
On 9 October 1954 the last French troops crossed the Long Biên Bridge.
On the morning of 10 October 1954, units of the Vietnamese People's Army, including the Capital Regiment, entered the inner city through the gates and took over Hà Nội, welcomed by large crowds.
After that day there were no French troops in Hà Nội.
The city was taken over and run by a Military Administrative Committee.
The Long Biên Bridge is one of the places linked with that day.
